verses.text: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

segments.text: Give the king thy judgments, O God,
And thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

verses.text: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.

segments.text: He will judge thy people with righteousness,
And thy poor with justice.

verses.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.

segments.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people,
And the hills, in righteousness.

verses.text: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.

segments.text: He will judge the poor of the people,
He will save the children of the needy,
And will break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.text: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

segments.text: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth,
And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

verses.text: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.

segments.text: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass,
As showers that water the earth.

verses.text: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

segments.text: In his days shall the righteous flourish,
And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

verses.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.

segments.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea,
And from the River unto the ends of the earth.

verses.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.

segments.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him;
And his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

segments.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute:
The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.

segments.text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him;
All nations shall serve him.

verses.text: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.

segments.text: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth,
And the poor, that hath no helper.

verses.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.

segments.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy,
And the souls of the needy he will save.

verses.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:

segments.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence;
And precious will their blood be in his sight:

verses.text: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.

segments.text: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba:
And men shall pray for him continually;
They shall bless him all the day long.

verses.text: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.text: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:

segments.text: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel,

verses.text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.

verses.text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
